fit
Take your outfit from day to night in the most effortless way with this forest green midi dress. Tying at the waist with a belt, it offers a flattering and classic silhouette you’ll feel comfortable in. We’ve designed it with button fastenings running down the front of the dress, as well as contrast stitch detailing on the seams. You’ll also find a collar at the neck and elasticated cuffs on the sleeves. This dress is all about the detail, so choose your accessories carefully in browns and neutrals for the complete look.

Size

  • Fit: Regular Fit
  • Length: 120cm Side neck point to hem

Other details

  • Fastening: Button
  • Sleeve length: Long Sleeve

Style code: 10024680693

Material

Details

  • Composition: Polyamide 44% Modal 20% Cotton 20% Elastane 13%
  • Care: Delicate Machine Wash
